title: Application profiles
description: A profile brings a site's hardening rules and, for new sites, its web root folder. Copy a built-in profile to make your own.
builtinNoChange: {{title}} is built in and cannot be changed. Copy it instead.
changeDescription: Sites that use this profile get the new rules right away and keep their own changes. The web root folder only applies to new sites.
copyDescription: A copy is your own profile: change its values, then pick it for new sites or on a site's Hardening tab.
saved: Profile {{name}} saved. Sites that use it got the new rules.

delete.title: Delete the profile {{name}}?
delete.text: Only a profile that no site uses can be deleted.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameHintEdit: The name cannot change; copy the profile for a new one.
editor.title: Title
editor.typeHint: Static profiles are offered for static sites.
editor.typeHintEdit: Cannot change while sites use the profile.
editor.webDirHint: Below htdocs, such as public; empty for htdocs. Only for new sites.
editor.pageCacheHint: Offered when the page cache is turned on
editor.configFiles: Block database dumps, backups, logs and editor copies
editor.pathHint: One per line, relative to the document root. At most {{max}}.
editor.cronHint: One per line: schedule, then command, such as */5 * * * * php cron.php. Shown, never created.
editor.checklistHint: One note per line, shown after a site is created

import.title: Import a profile
import.description: A profile exported from this or another Hostashi panel, in YAML with version: 1.
import.yamlHint: Or paste it here. The name must not be taken; edit it here to import a profile twice.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read.
import.empty: Paste the YAML or choose a file.

problems.name: Use up to {{max}} lower-case letters, digits and dashes for the name, starting with a letter.
problems.title: Give the profile a title.
problems.minPhp: Write the lowest PHP version like 8.2, or leave it empty.
problems.cron: The cron job "{{line}}" needs a schedule and a command.

errors.not_found: The profile does not exist anymore.
errors.profile_exists: A profile with this name exists already.
errors.profile_builtin: Built-in profiles cannot be changed or deleted. Copy one instead.
errors.profile_in_use: {{message}} Give those sites another profile first.
errors.failed: The profile could not be saved. Try again.
